note: The newest GPU display driver security bulletin per vendor, and the first fixed Windows driver in each driver branch. Read from the vendor's own bulletin; update this file when a newer bulletin is published. A driver in a branch newer than every branch listed is taken as current. GeForce numbers are used where GeForce and workstation drivers differ, so a GeForce driver is never called out of date wrongly.
